fixture_kind: Six unchanged pinned mozilla/pdf.js corpus originals; tracemonkey.pdf is a published paper; the other five are upstream fixtures, not claimed as user production documents
retrieval: Reuse original evidence from tmp/pdf-gap-investigation/report.json. Validate byte size, SHA-256 and Git blob SHA before and after extraction. Never regenerate or rewrite sources.
license_note: Sources used for local testing only; individual fixture redistribution rights not reviewed. No PDF binaries committed.
limits: Four successful CLI outputs are compared as exact JSON except elapsed_ms and exact literal text; two existing unsupported-encoding panics are tracked separately.
pypdf and Poppler are independent consumers with different ordering/spacing/mapping behavior; only explicit anchors are asserted, not full-text or visual equivalence.
Literal ligatures remain unnormalized; whitespace folding for evidence anchors does not change the product search contract.
The historical symlink race proves checked-versus-parsed source identity mismatch; no input-size bypass exploit was demonstrated.
This corpus checker does not prove race absence, bounded-read safety, OCR, layout fidelity, browser/native UI, or whole DOC/DOCX/PDF phase completion.
No source PDFs are generated, modified, re-saved, or rendered by this checker.
